description: This file defines the StandardSessionConnection class, which manages session read/write/delete operations in DynamoDB using the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements methods for reading session data, writing session data, deleting sessions, and deleting expired sessions, interfacing with DynamoDB tables.

classes.name: StandardSessionConnection
classes.description: A class implementing a session connection interface for DynamoDB, handling session read/write/delete and expired session cleanup using the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the connection with a DynamoDbClient instance and configuration array.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data associated with a given session ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in DynamoDB, with expiration timestamp and optional data attribute handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a session record from DynamoDB by session ID.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Scans DynamoDB for expired sessions and deletes them in batch.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats the session ID into a DynamoDB key array.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Triggers a PHP warning/error message for DynamoDB related errors.
